name: Teen Volunteer League
what_you_do: Join teen volunteer events like craft kits and trying out classes. Make a literary magazine, or join online advisory boards. You earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students in Orange County. Age and grade rules vary by event. Check with your branch.
pay_detail: Unpaid; earns community service hours (up to 2 hours per event)
deadline_text: Register for upcoming events at participating branches.
how_to_apply: Register for an event at a participating branch. Questions: AskOCLS@ocls.org or 407-835-7323.
notes: Advisory boards give 1 hour of service for each monthly online meeting. For the literary magazine you must send in work to get hours.
